NOISE Magazine is an independent bi-monthly magazine that has been operating since 2014 and
offers broadly defined extreme yet adventurous music. From the very beginning of our activity, we
have been guided by the goal of presenting high-quality music – without paying attention to the
narrow genre boundaries that are becoming increasingly blurred in the 21 st century. Keeping our
fingers on the pulse of modern times, we move in a wide stylistic spectrum: from metal (in its classic
and challenging varieties) through industrial / noise, hardcore / punk to indie rock, non-mainstream
hip-hop and dark electronics.
Over the years, our covers have hosted such diverse bands & artists as Ghost, Napalm Death, Lingua
Ingota, Killing Joke, Diamanda Galás, Kobong, Mgła, Idles and Wardruna. However, we do not
ignore smaller, niche projects, which in a moment may become the next big thing on the scene. On
our pages you will find extensive interviews, thematic album rankings, in-depth profiles of artists and
many reviews.

Although we worship to the ideals of ​​"DIY" with all our strength, our texts are written by
experienced, competent and passionate journalists with many years of experience. Some of us know
the music industry from the other side of the barricade - they were themselves playing in bands or
managing artists. This broadens our perspective and provides sensitivity to details that some listeners
may not detect. We deliver you the goods and tirelessly strive to separate the wheat from the
musical chaffs.
